title: Okay but, not great!
text: Okay but, not great!. Cheap and little. Maybe ok if you need to put in smaller location? The door on the hinge is half-working..not that great. Blinking tea light barely lights through it.

product_metadata.title: Tabletop Hanging Candle Holder Lantern on a Stand - Colorful Stained Glass
features: Made of stained glass shaped as a lantern with a curved iron stand giving it a classic look
Can be used indoors or outdoors
Perfect for any special occasions or as a gift
description: This candle holder is made of colorful mosaic stained glass in the shape of a lantern and is held by an iron stand. The dimensions of this lamp are 3.9” X 3.9 X 9”. The candle stand can be placed both indoors and outdoors. It adds beauty to any room in which it is placed. Through the colorful stained glass, the flame of the tea light or candle casts soft, warm light in the room. You can use this candle stand at any special occasions. You can also gift this candle stand to your near and dear ones at a wedding, engagement, housewarming, or any other special occasion.
